decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt extends Söbbeke's flagship biodynamic range, which is central to the brand's announced organic direction and was publicly promoted two years in a row, so management will persist with it and attribute any weak sales to temporary market conditions.
The mild sliced cheese launched only in 2024 and has its own product page, signalling visible commitment and investment in the cheese line, so it is too early for management to concede failure.
The sliced butter cheese was launched alongside B as part of the same publicly presented sliced-cheese expansion, so sunk investment and the need to justify the recent decision favour keeping it.
